《上海日报》（Journal de Shanghai）：

争夺银行控制权

目前，宋子文集团的金融家与一个独立集团的金融家之间正在进行激烈的斗争。
宋子文正寻求确保对获准发行钞票的十家大银行的控制权，即：中央银行、中国银行、交通银行、中国商业银行、宁波商业银行、中国农业工业银行、国货银行、中国实业银行、中国土地发展银行以及中国和南洋银行。
控制这些银行将带来对所有华商银行进行严密监管的权力，而这最终将导致仅允许中央银行拥有发钞权。
由宋子文和孔祥熙领导的集团目前控制着以下国家银行：中央银行、中国银行、交通银行和国货银行，以及以下私营银行：浙江兴业银行和宁波商业银行。
大型独立银行包括：上海商业储蓄银行和中国和南洋银行，以及与这两家银行有关联的下列三家银行：金城银行、嘉华银行（Gabelle Bank）和大陆银行。
据信，这些大型独立银行迟早将被迫服从宋子文集团的控制。

J. Fantos.

主题 国民政府接管中国银行和交通银行的控制权
撰写人 D.S. McKeown 转呈人 H. Grufth A.I.

国民政府已决定向中国银行拨款2,500万美元，向交通银行拨款1,000万美元，表面上是为了加强这两家华商银行的地位，但实际上是为了获得对中国金融界的完全控制。
鉴于争取外贷谈判失败，蒋介石将军认为这种独家控制是必要的。
交通银行的资本由个人认购的800万元和政府认购的200万元组成，此次新增拨款将使其资本增至2,200万元。该行经理唐寿民（Tang Shen-ming）因与政府关系良好，对该提议未提出异议。
中国银行原有资本2,500万元，其中2,000万元由个人认购，500万元由政府认购。国民政府新增的2,500万美元拨款将使政府的认购额增至3,000万元，从而确立其对银行的绝对控制。
此前，中国银行的股票年收益率为7%，但新债券的年回报率仅为6%，因此所有股票的利率将降低1%。这一变更遭到该行总经理张公权（Chang Kung Chuen）的强烈反对。为了克服这一阻力，蒋介石将军向张发出警告，如果他不离开上海

FURTHER CHANGES
IN PERSONNEL OF
BANKING HOUSES

Commercial Bank of China's
New Chairman

NOW UNDER CONTROL OF
GOVERNMENT

Another Chinese bank, which has a
note issue, was virtually put under
Government supervision yesterday,
when Mr. Tu Yueh-sung, director of
the Bank of China, and Mr. Koo Yi-
ku, a Government appointee on the
recently established Native Banks
Supervisory Committee, were appoint-
ed chairman and general manager, re-
spectively, of the Commercial Bank
of China. Both Mr. Tu and Mr. Koo,
who are understood to have been re-
commended by the Ministry of
Finance to take charge of the institu-
tion, will assume their new posts to-
day. The appointment was officially
announced at a directors' meeting
held at the offices of the bank, on the
Bund, yesterday morning.

An official of the Commercial Bank
of China, interviewed by a repre-
sentative of the "North-China Daily
News," stated that the Bank has always
been and is in a sound condition. Mr.
Fu Siao-an, former chairman of the
Chinese General Chamber of Com-
merce, who had been for many years
chairman of the Board of Directors
of the Commercial Bank of China,
resigned owing to illness, as in the
case of Mr. Liu Ti-chih, general
manager of the Ningpo Commercial
Bank, whose posts were taken over
by Mr. T. D. Woo and Mr. Churtong
Chih, respectively.

Mr. Tu Yueh-sung, the new chair-
man, has been a director of the in-
stitution, while Mr. Koo Yi-ku, the
general manager—a post established
only yesterday—was formerly general
manager of the Kiangsu Bank. Mr. Fu,
the retired chairman, will remain a
director of the bank.

Sixth Change

The change in the personnel of
Chinese banking institutions is the
sixth of note since the installation of
Mr. T. V. Soong, former Minister of
Finance, as chairman of the Bank of
China, and the increase in the number
of directors of the Bank of Com-
munications and the Central Bank.
While these three changes resulted
from an increase in the Government
capital, no capital has been put into
the Industrial Bank of China, the
Ningpo Commercial Bank, and the
Commercial Bank of China by the
Government.

In a notice issued by the Shanghai
City Government, Gen. Wu Te-chen,
the Mayor, stated that the financial
situation had been calmed with the
distribution by the Government
of $25,000,000 in Currency Bonds
among the native banks in need of
financial aid. Any body found to be
spreading malicious rumours affecting
the market would be severely dealt
with by the authorities.

The three representatives of the
Native Goods Promotion Committee
who interviewed Mr. H. H. Kung, Vice-
Minister of Finance, regarding the
Bank of China, asked for an
extension of the proposed six per cent.
loan to commercial banks, and also
concerning the possibility of a loan
of Mr. T. V. Soong's personal funds.
Gen. Wu Te-chen stated that the
Shanghai Municipal Government had
no intention of interfering with the
banks. Regarding the extension of
the loan, he said that it was a matter
for the banks themselves to decide.
He also stated that the Government
would not interfere with the internal
affairs of the banks.

银行机构
人事进一步变动

中国商业银行
新任董事长

现已处于
政府控制之下

昨日，又一家拥有发钞权的华商银行实际上置于政府监管之下，当时中国银行董事杜月笙先生和政府最近成立的华商银行监理委员会委任委员顾翊群（Koo Yi-ku）先生分别被任命为中国商业银行董事长和总经理。据悉，杜、顾二人均由财政部推荐接管该机构，他们将于今日就职。该项任命是在昨日上午于外滩该行办公室举行的董事会议上正式宣布的。

中国商业银行的一位官员在接受《字林西报》记者采访时表示，该行一直且目前状况良好。前上海总商会会长、多年来担任中国商业银行董事会主席的傅筱庵（Fu Siao-an）先生因病辞职，正如宁波商业银行总经理刘季直（Liu Ti-chih）先生的情况一样，他们的职位分别由吴鼎昌（T. D. Woo）先生和朱通（Churtong Chih，音译）先生接任。

新任董事长杜月笙先生一直是该行的董事，而总经理顾翊群先生——该职位是昨日才设立的——前任江苏银行总经理。退休董事长傅先生将继续担任该行董事。

第六次变动

自前财政部长宋子文先生出任中国银行董事长，以及交通银行和中央银行增加董事人数以来，这是华商银行机构人事发生的第六次引人注目的变动。虽然这三次变动是由于政府资本增加所致，但政府并未向中国实业银行、宁波商业银行和中国商业银行投入任何资本。

在上海市政府发布的一则公告中，市长吴铁城将军表示，随着政府向需要财政援助的钱庄分发2,500万元的货币公债，金融局势已趋于平静。当局将对任何被发现散布影响市场的恶意谣言的人予以严厉惩处。

国货维持会的三位代表就中国银行一事采访了财政部副部长孔祥熙（H. H. Kung）先生，要求将拟议中的六厘贷款扩展至商业银行，并询问是否可能动用宋子文先生的个人资金进行贷款。吴铁城将军表示，上海市政府无意干涉银行事务。关于贷款扩展问题，他说这是由银行自行决定的事项。他还表示，政府不会干涉银行的内部事务。

（批注：rde K.I.）

This new situation has permitted the Nanking Government to proceed indirectly with the reorganization of the Board of Directors and the General Management of the Bank of China by appointing T.V. The reorganization of the Bank of Communications is equally imminent.
In financial circles, it is believed that the government will proceed as follows in order to realize its programme for the financial unification of the country :-
1) To increase its holdings in the three government banks.

交通银行的改组同样迫在眉睫。
金融界认为，为了实现国家金融统一的计划，政府将采取以下步骤：
1) 增加在三大政府银行中的持股。
2) 接管中国银行和交通银行的管理权。
3) 将中国银行转变为专门从事汇兑业务的银行，将交通银行转变为从事商业运营的政府机构。
4) 随后，这三家银行将合并为一家特殊的国家银行。届时，中国银行将承担扩大后的中央银行的所有汇兑业务，而交通银行将承担所有普通银行业务。

pages.en:
The reorganization of the Bank of China is
being diversely commented upon in Chinese circles.
Some congratulate the government's initiative which
they regard as a presage of the nation's financial
unity; others fear that absolute control of the banks
will give rise to abuses on the part of the authorities
as had happened in the past.
The Ministry of Finance states that the
debenture bonds will be issued at par. 60% of the
proceeds ($60,000,000) will be used as a reserve
to increase the capital of the three banks and the
balance will be used to repay the advances made by the
Central Bank of China to the Central Government.

J. Fantos.

中国各界对中国银行的改组议论纷纷。
一些人祝贺政府的举措，视其为国家金融统一的前兆；另一些人则担心，对银行的绝对控制会导致当局像过去那样出现滥用职权的行为。
财政部声明，公债债券将按面值发行。所得款项的60%（6,000万美元）将用作储备金，以增加三家银行的资本，其余款项将用于偿还中央银行向中央政府提供的垫款。

The Kiangnan Tseng Pao, a Japanese Newspaper in Chinese

REPORTED WITHDRAWAL OF DEPOSIT FROM
BANK OF CHINA

Since April 14 Mr. T.V. Soong has been
exchanging views with local Foreign bankers on the financial
question. As a result, he has secured a promise from the
foreign bankers to refrain from exporting silver for the
time being.
However, owing to the activities of
Communist Army, the Nanking Government have to appropriate
a large sum to meet the military expenses in Szechuen and
Kweichow Provinces. Each military official in Szechuen
is given $20,000 or $40,000 per month. The military
expenses for Kweichow are fixed at $400,000 or $500,000
per month. Yunnan is also given a similar sum. The
Nanking Government is experiencing difficulty in raising
the funds.
After the reorganization of the Bank
of China, over 30 employees of Chang Kung Chuen's clique
were dismissed.
The Bank of Communications will hold a
meeting of shareholders to-day to discuss the question of
its reorganization.
The chaotic economic condition
has caused excitement among depositors with the Bank of China.
In consequence, the number of depositors withdrawing money from
the Bank of China is increasing daily. Although these depositors
have not yet deposited their money with Foreign banks, it is
presumed that a monetary crisis will occur in Shanghai before
the Dragon Boat Festival.

CHANG KIA NGAU TO TAKE UP THE POST OF
VICE GOVERNOR OF CENTRAL BANK

At the request of Dr. H.H. Kung, Minister of
Finance, Chang Kia Ngau, the former Managing Director of the
Bank of China, will officially take up the post of Vice
Governor of the Central Bank of China on April 27.

中文日文报纸《江南增报》刊登如下报道：- 1935年4月20日

传闻从中国银行提取存款

自4月14日以来，宋子文先生一直就金融问题与当地外籍银行家交换意见。结果，他已获得外籍银行家暂时停止输出白银的承诺。
然而，由于共军的活动，南京政府必须拨出巨款以应付四川和贵州省的军费开支。四川每位军事官员每月获发2万或4万美元。贵州的军费定为每月40万或50万美元。云南也获得类似数额的拨款。南京政府在筹集资金方面正面临困难。
中国银行改组后，张公权（Chang Kung Chuen）派系的30多名雇员被解雇。
交通银行将于今日召开股东会议，讨论其改组问题。
混乱的经济状况导致中国银行的储户产生恐慌。因此，从中国银行提款的储户人数日益增加。虽然这些储户尚未将钱存入外籍银行，但据推测，在端午节之前上海将发生货币危机。

张嘉璈就任中央银行副总裁

应财政部长孔祥熙博士的要求，中国银行前总经理张嘉璈（Chang Kia Ngau）将于4月27日正式就任中央银行副总裁一职。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, March 30, 1935

Bank Shareholders
In Annual Meeting

Government Control Of
Bank Of China Is An
Accomplished Fact

Close Cooperation In
Credit Relief Is Seen

Directors May Meet To
Name New Chairman
This Evening

Government control of the Bank
of China was being officially com-
pleted this afternoon at a meeting
of shareholders which got under
way at the Shanghai Chinese Bank-
ers' Association late in the day.
During the meeting, the re-
signation of Mr. Chang Kia-ngau,
as managing director and general
manager of the bank, and his ac-
ceptance of his new post as deputy
governor of the Central bank was
to be announced. Appreciation of
Mr. Chang's leading position in
Shanghai banking for more than
22 years was expressed.

Directors To Meet
The shareholders' meeting was
to be followed by a directors' meet-
ing, at which time, it has been re-
liably reported, Dr. T. V. Soong,
member of the Standing Committee
of the National Economic Council
and former Minister of Finance,
was expected to be named as chair-
man of the board and general
manager for the Bank of China.
The usual procedure would be for
a meeting of directors two days
after the shareholders' meeting,
however.
Measures to be discussed during
the meeting although no definite
action was expected, included the
suggestion that the government
might find it advisable to confine
the authority to issue notes to those
banks in which the Government
has direct control, which today
would include the Central Bank,
the Bank of China and the Bank
of Communications, the "big three"
of Shanghai banking houses.

The Annual Report
Use of a portion of the new
$100,000,000 Currency Bond issue to
increase the capital of the Bank
of China and other banks definitely
gives the government control of
the majority of shares.
The shareholders' meeting, aside
from the official announcement of
Mr. Chang's resignation as the chief
executive and his acceptance of his
post at the Central Bank, was to
be conducted according to the usual
routines. Mr. Li Mons, chairman of
the Board of Directors, will make
the annual report.
The increase of the government
interest is now an accomplished
fact. Inasmuch as the Currency
Bonds with a face value of $25,000,-
000 already have been received at
the offices of the bank.
The changes caused by the in-
crease of the Government inter-
ests in the bank were discussed at
a meeting of the Board of Directors
which took place yesterday after-
noon. It was during that meeting
it was learned today from reliable
sources that Mr. Chang's resigna-
tion as chief executive of the bank
had been acted upon. It was also
learned that the number of Gov-
ernment appointed directors had
been increased from three to nine
persons and the number of Govern-
ment appointed supervisors from
one to three persons. Dr. Soong is
to become one of the directors and
eventually chairman of the Board
of Directors and general manager
of the bank.

Increase Directors
During the meeting, it also was
decided to increase the number of
Government appointed directors
from three to nine persons and to
increase the number of Government
appointed supervisors from one to
three persons. Dr. Soong is to be-
come one of the directors and even-
tually chairman of the Board of
Directors and general manager of
the bank.
With the increase of the Govern-
ment interests in the bank, the
capital of the bank has been in-
creased to $49,712,280 with the Gov-
ernment holding $30,000,000. The
total assets of the bank are repre-
sented as $1,000,000,000 with
$700,000,000 deposits and about
$260,000,000 in banknotes now in
circulation.

Dr. Kung's View
Dr. H. H. Kung, Minister of
Finance, when interviewed by the
Kuo Min News Agency with regard
to the increase of the capital and
certain changes in the personnel of
the Boards of Directors of the three
leading Chinese Banks, namely, The
Central Bank, the Bank of China
and Bank of Communications, stated
that it has long been the policy of
the Government to further streng-
then these three banks.
Dr. Kung remarked that in view
of the general depression existing in
late years, and the further aggrava-
tion of the situation as a result
of the recent American silver
policy, it is desirable to have the
three banks cooperate with one an-
other to the fullest extent in order
to assist the money market here.

Close Cooperation
No significant changes are con-
templated in respect to the Bank
of Communications except addi-
tional Government representation
on the Board of Directors.
These changes are made, how-
ever, for the purpose of securing
fullest cooperation between the three
banks, and to provide a solid
foundation for the Chinese bank-
ing system.
Dr. Kung made it clear that the
close cooperation of the three lead-
ing Chinese banks has no connec-
tion whatever with the Govern-
ment's policy in respect to the
monetary situation and that these
three banks will retain their indi-
vidual entities.
Dr. Kung emphasized that by
working together these three banks
will be most helpful to the Govern-
ment in its desire to assist the
money market here, which has late-
ly manifested a more healthy con-
dition, and that he is looking to-
ward further improvements in the
financial structure of China.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1935年3月30日，星期六

银行股东
出席年度会议

政府控制
中国银行已成既定事实

信贷救济方面的
密切合作可见一斑

董事们可能于今晚
开会任命新董事长

今天下午，在上海华商银行公会举行的股东会议上，政府对中银行的控制在官方层面即将完成。
会议期间，宣布该行总经理兼经理张嘉璈先生辞职，并接受其在新职位——中央银行副理事长的任命。会议表达了对张先生在上海银行业超过22年的领导地位的赞赏。

董事将开会
据悉，股东会议之后将举行董事会议，届时，国民经济委员会常务委员、前财政部长宋子文博士预计将被任命为中国银行董事长兼总经理。
不过，通常的程序是在股东会议两天后举行董事会议。
会议期间将讨论的措施，尽管预计不会采取任何具体行动，包括建议政府可能认为明智的做法是将发行钞票的权力限制在政府直接控制的银行，即今天的中央银行、中国银行和交通银行，也就是上海银行业的“三大行”。

年度报告
使用新发行的1亿美元法币债券中的一部分来增加中国银行和其他银行的资本，这确实使政府控制了多数股份。
除了正式宣布张先生辞去首席执行官职务并接受其在中央银行的职位外，股东会议将按照常规程序进行。董事会主席李铭先生将作年度报告。
政府权益的增加现已成为既定事实。因为面值2,500万美元的法币债券已经收到并存入该行的办公室。
昨天下午举行的董事会会议上讨论了因政府在该行权益增加而引起的变化。正是在那次会议上，今天从可靠消息来源获悉，张先生辞去该行首席执行官职务一事已获处理。还获悉，政府委派的董事人数已从三人增加到九人，政府委派的监察人人数已从一人增加到三人。宋博士将成为董事之一，并最终担任董事会主席及该行总经理。

增加董事人数
会议期间，还决定将政府委派的董事人数从三人增加到九人，并将政府委派的监察人人数从一人增加到三人。宋博士将成为董事之一，并最终担任董事会主席及该行总经理。
随着政府在该行权益的增加，该行资本已增至49,712,280美元，其中政府持有3,000万美元。该行总资产据称为10亿美元，其中存款7亿美元，目前流通的银行券约2.6亿美元。

孔博士的观点
财政部长孔祥熙博士在接受国民新闻社采访时，就中国三大银行（即中央银行、中国银行和交通银行）资本增加及董事会人员变动一事表示，进一步加强这三家银行一直是政府的政策。
孔博士指出，鉴于近年来普遍存在的萧条，以及近期美国白银政策导致局势进一步恶化，这三家银行有必要最大限度地相互合作，以协助本地的货币市场。

密切合作
除在董事会中增加政府代表外，交通银行方面并未考虑进行重大变更。
然而，进行这些变更的目的是为了确保三家银行之间的充分合作，并为中国银行体系奠定坚实的基础。
孔博士明确表示，中国三大银行的密切合作与政府在货币形势方面的政策毫无关系，这三家银行将保留其各自的独立实体地位。
孔博士强调，通过共同努力，这三家银行将最有力地帮助政府实现协助本地货币市场的愿望，该市场最近表现出更健康的状况，并且他期待中国金融结构的进一步改善。

南京要求份额
（《晨报》）
南京，3月29日电。——南京商会已决定争取1亿美元法币债券中的一份份额。
该商会的市场恢复委员会今天决定向行政院请愿，分配价值500万美元的法币债券，以便该市各家银行组成财团，向急需资金的商店和工厂提供贷款。

昨日下午，在中国银行股东会议上，决定将银行资本从目前的2,500万美元增加至4,000万美元，会议决定接受额外1,500万美元的政府股份法币公债形式，使政府在银行的股份总额达到2,000万美元，从而与私人利益的股本相等。由于这一决定，银行章程已进行修订，董事总数增至21人，其中九人为政府委派，包括宋子文先生。

该决定是在昨日下午举行的银行年度股东会议上作出的，会上披露该年度净利润为1,933,317.01美元。中国银行的原始资本为2,500万美元，其中500万美元由政府认购。根据拟议发行的1亿美元法币公债，原计划分配给中国银行价值2,500万美元的法币公债，作为财政部对中国三大银行（中国银行、交通银行和中央银行）实行国有化方案的一部分。经过财政部长孔祥熙博士与中国银行官员之间的讨论，这笔金额减至1,500万美元，并在昨日的会议上获得批准。政府现在将持有银行资本的50%。

政府提名人选

据中央通讯社报道，银行董事会的九名政府委派人员为：
宋子文、叶琢堂、钱新之、杜月笙、吴达诠、奚德懋、宋汉章、胡笔江和王宝伦。

三名政府委派的监事为：李觉、赵棣华和王业松。

在政府决定通过发行民国二十四年度1亿美元法币公债（其中2,500万美元分配给中国银行）来增加其在中国银行的持股之前，只有三名政府委派的董事和一名政府委派的监事。

私人利益方

昨日宣布，代表私人股份的12名董事为：李铭、张嘉璈、冯耿光、宋汉章、陈辉森、孔祥熙、侯振勉、卞白眉、荣宗敬、周作民、贝祖诒和周良。

该行总经理张嘉璈先生已辞职，而该行董事长李铭先生也将不久辞职。然而，消息灵通人士认为，他们将在明天选举产生的董事会常务委员会中任职。

银行的年度报告在昨日的会议上获得通过，但定于周一发布以供出版。

T. V. Soong Interviewed

In an interview with newspaper reporters at
10 a.m. yesterday, Mr. T.V.Soong, member of the National
Economic Committee and concurrently Chairman of the Board
of Directors of the Bank of China, denied the report that
the National Government would assume economic control after

report that the Government will exercise control over the
issuing of banknotes by banks. I am of opinion that this
control will be exercised over provincial banks only".

Bank to be held on April 20. It is believed that the
present Board of Directors and the General Manager of the
Bank will not be changed but the appointment of a
Chairman for the Board of Directors will be decided at
a meeting to be held later

April 2, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

MEETING OF NEW BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF BANK OF CHINA.

The new Board of Directors of the Bank of
China held a meeting at 4 p.m. yesterday. Seventeen
directors, 9 representing the Government and 8 representing
merchants, were present. Dr. H.H. Kung, Minister of
Finance, presided.
The following resolutions were passed :-
(1) That the resignations of Mr. Chang Chia-ngau as
Chairman of the Board of Directors, and of Mr. Lee
Foh-sung as Director, be accepted.
(2) That Messrs. Tien-Sing-ts, Wong Pao-lung, Tu Yuet-sen,
T.V. Soong (representing the Government), Feng Keng-
kwang, Soong Han-tsaung and Zung Hwei-tuh (representing
merchants) be appointed as Managing Directors.
In accordance with the regulations, Dr. H.H.
Kung has appointed Mr. T.V. Soong as Chairman of the Board
of Managing Directors.
At a meeting of the Board of Managing
Directors (Mr. T.V. Soong presiding), it was resolved to
appoint Mr. Soong Han-tsaung as General Manager of the
Bank of China.

《华中日报》（汪精卫的官方机关报）及其他本地报纸：- 35-4-3（上午）

重组后的中国银行

新任董事长宋子文先生和新任总经理宋汉章先生于昨天上午9时20分正式就职。上午10时30分，他们接见了重要职员。据信，随着银行的重组，将会引入改进措施，但职员队伍不会发生变化。
在接受记者采访时，宋子文先生否认了有关政府将在增加其在中国银行、交通银行和中央银行的持股后采取通货膨胀政策的谣言。他表示，政府将继续采用银本位制，并且不会引入不适合中国的经济政策。

关于将其在交通银行的持股增加1,000万美元一事，将在4月20日举行的银行股东会议上进行讨论。据信，该行现任董事会和总经理不会变更，但董事会主席的任命将在稍后举行的会议上决定。

1935年4月2日。下午译文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

中国银行新董事会会议。

中国银行新董事会于昨天下午4时举行会议。出席会议的有17名董事，其中9名代表政府，8名代表商界。财政部长孔祥熙博士主持了会议。
通过以下决议：-
(1) 接受张嘉璈先生辞去董事会主席职务，以及李馥荪先生辞去董事职务。
(2) 任命田兴之、王宝伦、杜月笙、宋子文（代表政府）、冯耿光、宋汉章和荣惠笃（代表商界）为常务董事。
根据规定，孔祥熙博士已任命宋子文先生为常务董事会主席。
在常务董事会会议上（由宋子文先生主持），决议任命宋汉章先生为中国银行总经理。

March 30, 1935.    C    Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :

T. V. SOONG AND SIR VICTOR SASSOON'S SCHEME.

At his residence yesterday morning Mr. T.V.
Soong received local financial leaders, including Yih Tsoh
Daung(葉琢堂), Tang Shou Ming(唐壽民), Li Foh Sung
(李蓀) and Zih Tuh Mow(席德懋) with whom he discussed
the stabilization of local finance and the proposals of Sir
Victor Sassoon for the relief of the situation.
Later Mr. Soong released the following
information to newspaper reporters:- "In his scheme for
the relief of the financial stringency in Shanghai, Sir
Victor Sassoon suggests the issue of Shanghai pound notes.
Personally I am of the opinion that this scheme, if put into
effect, would be liable to upset China's finance because it
will add another form of currency to the ones already in
use. I do not agree with Sir Victor's scheme; the Ministry
of Finance will likewise disapprove. The present instability
of China's finance is due to the inconsistent state of mind
on the part of the people; therefore to stabilize the
financial situation, it is necessary first to remove this
condition. I am examining the proposals of local real
estate owners to issue bonds to the amount of $450,000,000
to find out whether this would relieve the market. It has
long been the intention of the Government to induce the
Central Bank, the Bank of China and the Bank of Communications
to amalgamate so that there will be one central unit to deal
with critical situations when they arise. The Government
has appointed Mr. Chang Kung Chun as Deputy Governor of the
Central Bank; and I shall be appointed as a director of the
Bank of China because the bank's regulations stipulate that
the Government has the right to appoint directors to the
bank. There will be no change in the present system of
the Bank of China. The report that the Government will
appoint me as Chairman of the Board of Directors and
concurrently General Manager of the bank is incorrect.
It has not yet been decided whether the government will
appoint directors to the Bank of Communications."

1935年3月30日。 C 上午译文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

宋子文与维克多·沙逊爵士的方案。

昨天上午，宋子文先生在其寓所接待了本地金融界领袖，包括叶琢堂、唐寿民、李馥荪和席德懋，与他们讨论了稳定本地金融以及维克多·沙逊爵士提出的缓解局势的建议。
随后，宋子文先生向报记者发布了以下信息：“在缓解上海金融紧缩的方案中，维克多·沙逊爵士建议发行上海英镑券。我个人认为，如果实施该方案，可能会扰乱中国金融，因为它将在已使用的货币之外增加另一种形式的货币。我不同意维克多爵士的方案；财政部同样不会批准。目前中国金融的不稳定是由于民众心态不一致所致；因此，要稳定金融局势，首先必须消除这种状况。我正在审查本地房地产所有者提出的发行4.5亿美元债券的建议，以查明这是否能缓解市场状况。政府长期以来一直有意促使中央银行、中国银行和交通银行合并，以便在出现危机情况时有一个中心机构来处理。政府已任命张公权为中央银行副总裁；我将被任命为中国银行董事，因为银行章程规定政府有权向银行委派董事。中国银行的现行制度不会改变。有关政府将任命我为董事会主席兼银行总经理的报道是不实的。政府是否向交通银行委派董事尚未决定。”

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of Gen. Chiang Kai Shek)
and other local newspapers  3-3-35 (Afternoon)

BANK OF CHINA TO BE RE-ORGANIZED

The Ministry of Finance has decided to issue
on April 1 debenture bonds amounting to $100,000,000.
Of this amount, $30,000,000 will be handed to the
Central Bank of China, $25,000,000 to the Bank of China
and $10,000,000 to the Bank of Communications in order
to strengthen the financial position of the banks.
In consequence, the organization of these three banks
will be changed.
Chang Chia Ngau (張嘉璈), Managing-Director
of the Bank of China, has now been appointed Vice-Governor
of the Central Bank of China. It is said that T.V. Soong
will be appointed Managing-Director of the Bank of China.
A report was current yesterday to the effect
that the Bank of China and the Bank of Communications
will be re-organized.
Information secured from a certain banking
source shows that the appointment of Chang Chia Ngau,
Managing-Director of the Bank of China, to the post of
Vice-Governor of the Central Bank of China was made
with the object of expanding the business of the Central
Bank. The Ministry of Finance expects him to resign
from the post of Managing-Director of the Bank of China.
Shareholders of the Bank of China earnestly
hope that Chang Chia Ngau will not leave the bank as
he has rendered valuable service.
The Bank of China will hold a meeting of
shareholders on the afternoon of March 30 at the
Bankers' Association when the increase of the Government's
shares by $30,000,000 and the appointment of a new
Managing-Director of the bank will be discussed.

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方机关报）及其他本地报纸 1935年3月3日（下午）

中国银行将改组

财政部决定于4月1日发行总额为1亿美元的信用债券。其中，3,000万美元将拨给中央银行，2,500万美元拨给中国银行，1,000万美元拨给交通银行，以加强各银行的财务状况。因此，这三家银行的组织结构将发生变更。
中国银行总经理张嘉璈（Chang Chia Ngau）现已获任中央银行副总裁。据悉，宋子文（T.V. Soong）将被任命为中国银行总经理。
昨日有传闻称，中国银行和交通银行将进行改组。
从某银行界消息来源获得的信息显示，任命中国银行总经理张嘉璈为中央银行副总裁，旨在扩大中央银行的业务。财政部期望他辞去中国银行总经理一职。
中国银行的股东们恳切希望张嘉璈不要离开该行，因为他已提供了宝贵的服务。
中国银行将于3月30日下午在银行公会召开股东会议，讨论政府增资3,000万美元以及任命新任银行总经理事宜。
